# Coach Josh Official

> Boxing training programs, coaching, and digital courses from Coach Josh — a professional boxing coach and content creator with 150M+ views across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

## About

Coach Josh is a professional boxing coach based in Hamden, CT who creates structured boxing training content. His methodology focuses on fundamentals-first teaching: proper striking mechanics, footwork, defense, conditioning, and fight IQ.

## Products

### Striking Blueprint
A comprehensive interactive ebook covering beginner boxing fundamentals across 11 chapters. Topics include stance and balance, injury prevention, shadowboxing, heavy bag work, conditioning, core training, plyometrics, and weekly training structure.
- URL: https://www.coachjoshofficial.com/blueprint

### Elite Coaching
Premium 1-on-1 coaching with direct access to Coach Josh. Includes the Striking Blueprint, 60+ video course, and a custom training program.
- Price: $497 USD
- URL: https://www.coachjoshofficial.com
